trailhead.label: The car park by the Monte Siera chairlift at Cima Sappada, the board’s start

cautions: The start is beside the SR355 at Cima Sappada: keep your dog on a short lead at the car park.
The walk starts and ends near the Monte Siera chairlift and its ski runs: keep your dog close there.
A steady climb on forest track and path, a little tiring in places: take it slowly with an older dog.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
